Second Investment: production is complete and the economic confirmation is now frozen BEFORE fresh market outcomes.

Production campaign SHA256 7081c4b19c6df3558a86b4887b68bd8753ea287f73782701b308b3bc1cf34d2f, original source freeze 23e0203abc7ef56a6e9a0e26ec857210fb778777cbf05b6e68fcba5b9f90c664. A/B/C each accepted all 6 registered full-lock metadata questions: the same 2 declared-root conflicts and 4 metadata-consistent configurations. All 18 pip dry-runs exited 0; the two conflicts come from the unchanged project minimum requirements, not upstream defects. Mean complete-service seconds: A 1.135234, B 1.339685, C 1.175498. B was slower than both comparisons in all 6 cases. No human/customer effort saving, new demand, price premium, extra eventual output or application qualification is inferred. Independently authored same-session verification and archive review passed; this is not external customer acceptance.

Economic freeze SHA256 e6c9b8bd1a085459fedb8d22c1d47a9459b1793edd1093c85a1b39b278d96120; protocol c0bed72e9f87e7ec896e4bfa3c5a85a9d422ba31176403451d33866fa70a1ade; continuation 5248bd12b0130f2630d449aeda0d76c6ad78980a8cad45fb5c5907661aa29c26; runner 259bb8f7904a2f7005fb1e7fe21be05a8f12c356cd7681e840b849b26a48b96d. Additive namespace studies/agi-alpha-second-investment-v1.

Design: all new arms inherit the SAME existing first-asset B enterprise, USD1000 original seed, USD200 reserve, original 52-week service horizon, full historical opening cost, and prior favorable conditional fixed USD20/logit reference.13 predeclared conditions cover recurrence including zero, nonzero buyer integration, 13-week collections, cheap competent AI, price16, undercutting, integration failure, upkeep and quality shock.24 new seeds8001–8024; 3 complete cost scenarios USD25.97/103.85/415.40 plus upkeep; actual unidentified-cost profile retained separately. These are explicit allocations, not invoices or empirical cost bounds. Search includes prior failed discovery and rejected candidates. B/C get the same cost envelopes; only signed measured CPU differences enter the diagnostic subcent account at an ASSUMED USD1/core-hour tariff. Integer-cent production effect is zero.

Two predeclared policies: adaptive discovery/construction gate weeks26–40 and completed-research replay at week26 only. An affordable but uneconomic research attempt is never labeled an admitted worthwhile investment; any prototype cost not paid by the modeled enterprise remains an explicit outside research contribution in project-inclusive results. No future receipts or silent new capital.80 groups,1920 paired worlds/5760 histories;180-second execution budget, no outcome-dependent replacement/restart. Seed8001/reference/all cost profiles and both policies selected now for the demonstration.

Source invariants, cash reconciliation, unknown-cost handling, paired qualification and runner arithmetic were independently reviewed before execution. Prior papers, negative campaigns, DUPLEX/component/joint experiments and current release/product ownership remain unchanged. Proceeding to the one frozen economic campaign.
